topic: How to Wash Cotton Without Shrinking It
notes: Avoid claiming that all cotton garments behave the same. Shrinkage depends on fabric construction, finishing and whether the garment was preshrunk. The care label is the controlling instruction for washing and drying. Lower temperatures and gentler drying reduce thermal/mechanical stress, but do not promise zero shrinkage. Avoid giving a fixed wash temperature when the garment label differs.
